title: ADHD Planner 2027 Digital, Goodnotes Planner for iPad and Android, Daily Weekly Monthly, Time Blocking, Starts Oct 2026, Hyperlinked
description:
Just Today is a dated 2027 ADHD digital planner for adults who have bought pretty planners before and stopped using them. One calm page a day, every date linked, and it starts on Monday, October 26, 2026 so you can begin this week instead of waiting for January.

What's inside: 541 pages in one landscape PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that shows every section and month on one screen
- Start here: 4 short steps to get going
- Setup check: tap the buttons to test the links on your own device
- 2027 year at a glance (every date opens its day)
- 12 month pages with One goal this month
- 12 habit trackers, one for each month
- 53 week pages with This week's top 3, Weekly reset and Not this week
- 365 day pages
- Head start from Monday, October 26, 2026 to December 31: 2 month pages, 9 week pages and 67 day pages (the Dec 28 week is Week 1 of 2027)
- Fell off? Start again page
- Dopamine menu
- Routines: morning, leaving the house, evening wind-down
- Energy map for the whole year
- 4 brain dump pages and 8 notes pages

Good to know: landscape only. Weeks start on Monday. No stickers. It is not a fillable form: write with your pen or type with your app's text tool.

What makes it different
- Working in five minutes. The cover's Open planner button takes you to Start here, and the Setup check page shows the links work on your device before you plan anything. If a button does nothing, the fix list is right on that page.
- The same seven boxes every day: Today's top 3, Time blocks from 7am to 9pm, Brain dump, Energy 1 to 5 with Basics (meds or vitamins, water, a real meal), One win today and Dopamine break. One page to learn, and half of it is open space to write.
- A no-guilt way back. Missed a week? The Restart page says skip the gap, jump to today in two taps and write one thing. No catching up.
- Easy to get around. Month tabs run down the right edge of every page. A top bar takes you Home, to the Year, Restart, Dopamine, Energy, Brain dump and Notes. A Month / Week trail works as a back button, and day pages have previous and next arrows.
- Short on purpose. Not 50 templates, just the pages you will use every day.
- Start now. Pages from Monday, October 26, 2026 lead straight into January 2027.
- Calm to look at: warm cream paper, dark ink and soft teal, with text that stays crisp at any zoom.
- Help inside the file. The instructions are printed on the pages, not only in a video.

Works with
Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android tablets and Windows tablets. You need a PDF planner app like one of these to tap the links and write on the pages.
Not made for phones, e-ink tablets, or viewing in Files, Photos or Google Drive preview.
Links not tapping? Turn the pen off to follow a link and back on to write.

How to start
1. Download the file from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
2. Open the PDF in your planner app and import it as a PDF.
3. Tap the Setup check buttons, then tap Year and today's date (between October 26 and December 31, 2026, tap Head start on the Year page). Fill Today's top 3. That is the whole job for today.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser (Safari, Chrome) and go to Purchases. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
- Which app do I need? A PDF planner app: Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo or Noteshelf. Files, Photos and Drive preview can't follow links.
- The links don't tap. Turn the pen off (read or view mode). The Setup check page tests this in seconds.
- Can I type in it? Yes, with your app's text tool. It isn't a fillable form, so there are no typing boxes.
- Is there a portrait version? Not yet. This planner is landscape only.

What you get
- Just-Today.pdf (18.4 MB, 541 pages, landscape)
One PDF, not a zip, so it downloads and imports quickly.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
Message us on Etsy and we'll help you set it up.
